subtopic: Savings Bonds for Children and Education
source_evidence: Unlike other securities, minors may hold U.S. savings bonds in their own name. Tax benefits are available for eligible taxpayers when Series EE and Series I savings bonds are used for qualified education expenses.
answer: Savings bonds can be given to children, and a minor may hold a U.S. savings bond in their own name. They may also be used toward education expenses. Eligible taxpayers may qualify for tax benefits when Series EE or Series I bonds are used for qualified education expenses; eligibility requirements apply.
